description:
GUI surfaces cannot be verified headless (CLAUDE.md hard rule), so kpdf's new page add/delete (commit 094f50e) is untested in a real terminal/display.

To dogfood, on a real display with the Wacom:
- 'a' adds a blank page after the current one and jumps to it; check the page appears at the SAME size/zoom as the one you were on (it copies the neighbour's /MediaBox and /Rotate) and that the pen draws on it immediately.
- Ctrl+Delete removes the current page; check Undo restores it.
- '+ Page' / '- Page' toolbar buttons, which exist because lecturing with a tablet often leaves no hand free for the keyboard.
- Ctrl+S then reopen: the added pages and the ink on them must both survive.

Library side is already covered: 12 unit tests (flat + nested page trees, inherited size, insertion position, last-page refusal, append-only property) and an end-to-end check against the 78-page arXiv fixture where the inserted page rasterizes at 596x842.
title: kpdf page add/delete needs human dogfooding on a tablet
